🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your phone's brain, the microchip, is built with unimaginable precision!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Microchips are miniature cities with billions of transistors.
🔹 Engineers carve lines just a few atoms wide – thousands of times thinner than a human hair!
🔹 This atomic-scale accuracy creates the invisible marvels that power our digital world.
🔹 It's like drawing a perfect hair-thin line across an entire continent!
